about: Every number the pricing page, the front door's pay screen and its How it works fold show. Each holds its value, its unit, and either the law file and rule it comes from or the mark that it comes from no law. Read by scripts/site_pages.py and scripts/site_product.py at build time.

free_runs_per_day.unit: own-data runs a day, per browser
free_runs_per_day.source: not from a law: a starting value to be tested

pack_runs.source: not from a law: a starting value to be tested

pack_price.unit: US dollars of test money for one pack
pack_price.source: not from a law: a starting value to be tested

window._: L14 (IQ PLAN.md, MISSION Project_P_Master_Blueprint.md:604): the price window C / (1 - m) <= price <= B - R - S. A value that is not measured is null, and the pricing page shows it as not known yet, never 0.

cost_per_run.unit: US dollars one run costs Knos, failed runs included, over the latest runs
cost_per_run.source: not measured yet: the run records' time and model tokens (apps/wanted tool_run.py) do not reach this file yet

margin.unit: share of the price Knos keeps, from 0 to 1

person_cost.unit: US dollars a person spends today to check one test file against a limit

person_hours.unit: hours a person spends today to check one test file against a limit

risk.unit: US dollars of risk a person takes by moving the check to Knos

switching.unit: US dollars it costs a person to switch to Knos

plans._: L33: one paid tier, a flat monthly plan by default and a yearly plan, priced by region, in test money. The prices are the founder's choice: null until set.

covers.unit: free users one payer's plan should cover

paying_share.unit: percent of users expected to pay
